description: Edits an existing draft, scheduled, pending_approval or declined post in place: text, title, visibility, media, first comment / thread, or schedule time. Only the fields you pass change, and the previous values are overwritten with no undo. Posts already published or being processed cannot be edited. If the API key cannot publish directly, an edited scheduled post goes back to pending_approval.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment posted on the post right after it publishes (e.g. links or hashtags). Supported on platforms with comment support such as X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord.

mediaIds.description: New ordered list of media IDs from autoposter_list_media. Replaces the current media; [] removes all.

scheduledAt.description: New ISO timestamp or local datetime, e.g. '2026-10-05T14:00:00'. Must be in the future.

threadComments.description: Optional thread: follow-up texts posted in order after publishing, each replying to the previous one. If firstComment is also set, these come after it. On X this makes a tweet thread.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for scheduledAt. Defaults to the post's timezone, then UTC.

title.description: Optional title. Used by YouTube, Pinterest and WordPress; ignored elsewhere.

visibility.description: Optional audience for TikTok posts (default PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE). Ignored on other platforms.
